threads.title: Show the trip payout breakdown in the driver's shift summary

transcript.text: The rate card sums each operator's cut in floating point, so the fractions compound. Rounding now happens once, at the invoice boundary:

items: `rateCard.ts` — totals are accumulated in integer cents, fractions only at read time
`invoicePdf.ts` — the grand total passes through `roundToCurrency` before it prints
`ledger.test.ts` — replays 2,411 seeded invoices and pins every total to two decimals

transcript.text: Invoice #4827 now totals `61.30`, and the ledger replay matches it for the whole back catalog.
